$description: Icon-only action that inherits all Button variants and sizing, but requires an explicit accessible name.
name: Icon Button

behavior.action: Same behavior and state transitions as Button.
behavior.tooltip: Optional explanatory tooltip is not a substitute for the accessible name.
behavior.loading: Retain the button's hit area and accessible name while busy.

accessibility: Nonempty programmatic accessible name is mandatory even when a tooltip is shown.
Use a native button/control, not an unlabelled clickable icon.
Support keyboard activation and visible focus, including contextual contrast.

web: Use semantic HTML controls, keyboard focus-visible, and 24×24 CSS px minimum targets; prefer more space for touch.
Retain browser zoom and allow labels to wrap or controls to grow.
ios: Respect 44pt minimum interactive hit area and Dynamic Type; prefer native Button/Control semantics.
Use native enabled/disabled and accessibility label/state APIs.
android: Respect 48dp minimum interactive target and nonlinear font scaling; prefer native Compose/View control semantics.
Use native enabled/disabled and accessibility semantics.
